perspective:
Christian’s available information:

- Jonathan Balogun is his close childhood friend. Christian often seeks Jonathan’s advice on personal and professional matters and values his perspective; Jonathan is more educated and has a master’s degree.
- Recently, Christian felt anxious and suspicious that Jonathan was hiding something important from him. He arranged to meet Jonathan at their favorite coffee shop to confront him.
- At the meeting, Christian told Jonathan he felt something serious was being hidden. Jonathan said Christian could trust him. Christian pressed that Jonathan had been acting differently and asked him to explain.
- Jonathan admitted he had been keeping something from Christian: he is in some trouble and did not know how to tell him.
- Christian felt worried and empathetic and offered to help. Jonathan said the situation is complicated and he did not want to drag Christian into it. Christian insisted they face it together. Jonathan said he could use support and resources to figure a way out of the mess.
- Christian began to suspect the trouble might involve criminal/illegal activity. He asked Jonathan directly. Jonathan said he could not say for sure, that he might have gotten involved with the wrong people, but that he did not do anything illegal himself.
- Christian told Jonathan he would look into the matter discreetly. Jonathan thanked him and said he trusted Christian to handle it carefully.
- Through his own investigation, Christian came to believe Jonathan is being framed and that someone is trying to set him up. Christian told Jonathan this. Jonathan asked if he was sure and who might do it. Christian said he was not sure yet but had leads and planned to gather more evidence to prove Jonathan’s innocence.
- Later, Christian came to believe/found out that the real culprit is someone close to both him and Jonathan—someone they both know and trust. Christian told Jonathan this and said he planned to confront the person and bring them to justice. Jonathan warned him that the person is dangerous and said he trusted Christian to do what is right.
- The identity of the culprit is not named in the accessible dialogue, but Christian states that he has found out who is behind it.
